subject: Temporary standby credit & regional failover escalation amendment request
messages:
From: Jeremy Cole <j.cole@brightline.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-02 10:05 PST
Subject: Request: temporary standby credit + regional failover escalation

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick reaction during Friday night's flapping sessions. We understand the incident stretched beyond normal operating windows and appreciate the support your on-call team provided. A couple asks from Brightline as we get through the next two weeks of higher traffic: 

- Can Redwood provide a temporary standby credit for missed P1 SLA targets on 2027-10-29 and 2027-10-30? We logged two handoffs where the P1 acknowledgment window exceeded our contract during peak hours. Summary attached (postmortem-summary.txt).
- While our teams stabilize, we also want to formalize a short-term change to the escalation path so our SREs can be reached directly during the night window and we can permit a regional failover to our EU region when US capacity is constrained. Essentially: expand the P1 escalation list (add Brightline SRE) and allow Redwood to route to EU fallback for 00:00-06:00 PST for the next 14 days.

If we can get a written temporary amendment (start date next Monday, two-week duration) and a short mutual action plan documenting the modified on-call escalation, that would help our execs sign off quickly. Happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

Contacts: Jeremy Cole (me), and our primary SRE for this window is Maya Patel <maya.patel@brightline.ai>.

Thanks,
Jeremy
Jeremy Cole
Head of Platform Operations
Brightline AI

Attachments: postmortem-summary.txt
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jeremy Cole <j.cole@brightline.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-02 12:15 PST
Subject: Re: Request: temporary standby credit + regional failover escalation

Jeremy — thanks for the clear ask and the postmortem. I've looped Sean (Support Ops) and Laura (Customer Success) so we can move fast. High level from Redwood: we can approve a short-term amendment covering a two-week window to add your SRE contact to the P1 escalation list and enable controlled regional failover to EU for the overnight window, provided we capture a few guardrails. Draft attached (draft-temp-sla-amendment.pdf).

Proposed guardrails (quick bullets):
- Duration: 14 calendar days starting Monday 2027-11-08.
- P1 overnight acknowledgment window adjusted from 15 -> 30 minutes for the defined window (00:00-06:00 PST) for this amendment only.
- Brightline SRE (Maya Patel) to be added to the P1 escalation chain as escalation step 2; Redwood Ops remains first responder.
- Regional failover: Redwood will route to EU model serving under defined capacity-pressure thresholds only; all traffic routing will be logged and visible in the Console.
- Credit: a one-time standby credit equivalent to 10% of October usage, applied upon signature and acceptance of the amendment (subject to verification of the two flagged incidents).

Sean — can you confirm the suggested runbook level items (ack times, phone escalation, bridging protocol)? Laura — please confirm billing contacts for the credit and whether Brightline needs a formal PO or amendment signature.

If everyone is aligned I can push this as a short amendment for signature (DocuSign) and ask Legal to expedite.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: draft-temp-sla-amendment.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jeremy Cole <j.cole@brightline.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-02 14:03 PST
Subject: Re: Request: temporary standby credit + regional failover escalation — runbook details

Thanks — adding the runbook details below so the amendment can reference them. I attached a CSV-style escalation matrix/runbook (runbook-brightline-oncall.csv).

Key operational items (for inclusion in the amendment):
1) P1 definition: system outage affecting core inference endpoints with >50% error rate or total outage affecting customer production traffic.
2) Night window (00:00-06:00 PST) temporary acknowledgement target = 30 minutes; remediation SLA unchanged (time-to-resolution still aligned with existing contract tiers).
3) Escalation chain (simplified):
   - Redwood on-call (primary) -> Redwood ESCALATION TEAM (pager)
   - If no ack in 30m: Brightline SRE (Maya Patel) (added as escalation step 2) -> Brightline SRE to join bridge within 15m of escalation.
   - If unresolved after 90m: Redwood Ops Lead (pager) + Customer Success (Laura Bennett) + Brightline Engineering Manager.
4) Regional failover policy: Redwood will only route to EU hosting if both: (a) US serving latency > 3x baseline for 10 continuous minutes AND (b) EU serving shows healthy capacity as indicated in the Console. Failover is reversible within 5 minutes; all failover events will produce an audit record in the Console.
5) Bridge protocol: Redwood creates a triage bridge; Brightline SRE joins as participant and has read/write on the incident timeline.
6) Credit validation: Redwood will validate the two incidents from Oct 29/30 against logs; if validated, credit applied as described.

Operational notes / requests: please confirm Maya's mobile and escalation preferences; we need a signed contact authorization form for adding an external SRE to our escalation list. Legal will need the signed amendment to finalize credits.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Support Operations
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

Attachment: runbook-brightline-oncall.csv
From: Jeremy Cole <j.cole@brightline.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@brightline.ai>
Date: 2027-11-02 16:22 PST
Subject: Re: Request: temporary standby credit + regional failover escalation — runbook details

Vanessa / Sean — this looks good and granular, thank you. We accept the guardrails and runbook language. Confirming Maya Patel will be the SRE contact for the period; she can be reached at +1 617-555-0987 and maya.patel@brightline.ai. We also confirm Monday 2027-11-08 as the start date for the 14-day amendment.

Please send the DocuSign and we'll route to our legal and finance for signature. We consent to the audit logging condition for any failover event. Once signed, we'll proceed with the joint war room cadence for the first 72 hours.

Jeremy
Jeremy Cole
Head of Platform Operations, Brightline AI

Attachment: signed-request-stub.pdf
